headline: Strong Execution Drives Healthy Growth; Robust Order Book Enhances Visibility

highlights: Result Update 9th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 2,430 VA Tech Wabag Ltd Water Treatment 1 Strong Execution Drives Healthy Growth; Robust Order Book Enhances Visibility Est.

Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue - INLINE; EBITDA - BEAT; PAT - BEAT Change in Estimates Post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: -7%/9% ; EBITDA: -5%/3% ; PAT: -8%/3% Recommendation Rationale • Record Order Book Provides Strong Revenue Visibility: VA Tech Wabag’s robust order backlog of Rs 20,207 Cr, equivalent to over 4x its annual revenue base, provides strong medium-term revenue visibility.

Healthy order inflows of over Rs 5,200 Cr during H1FY27, coupled with a diversified project portfolio across domestic and international markets, underpin the company’s targeted 15–20% revenue CAGR. • Healthy Execution and Operating Leverage to Support Profitable Growth: Strong project execution drove 20% YoY revenue growth and 23% YoY PAT growth in Q2FY27, reflecting operating leverage and improving profitability.

Strategic focus on desalination, industrial wastewater treatment, semiconductor, data centre and other technology-led water solutions, along with the targeted increase in O&M contribution to 20% of revenue, is expected to strengthen its long-term growth prospects and earnings quality.
